name: Hofstadter Q-sequence: a(1) = a(2) = 1; a(n) = a(n-a(n-1)) + a(n-a(n-2)) for n > 2.
comment: Rate of growth is not known. In fact it is not even known if this sequence is defined for all positive n.
_Roman Pearce_, Aug 29 2014, has computed that a(n) exists for n <= 10^10. - _N. J. A. Sloane_
a(n) exists for n <= 3*10^10. - _M. Eric Carr_, Jul 02 2023
